title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: Ten named Samford study settings with documented room features, locations, and use rules.

cards.title: Third-Floor Individual Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Harwell G. Davis Library · third floor
cards.notes: Ask at the first-floor Circulation Desk for a key, then use an individual room for up to two hours; renew only if no one is waiting.
cards.short_summary: Locked individual rooms for one or two Samford students.
cards.evidence_claim: Davis Library's third-floor study rooms are for individual use by one or two Samford students and are first-come, first-served.
cards.source_title: Study Rooms Policy | Samford University Library
cards.access_notes: Available to Samford undergraduate and graduate students, excluding Law students; keys are checked out at Circulation for two-hour blocks and rooms cannot be reserved.

cards.title: Study Room 211
cards.subtitle: Harwell G. Davis Library · second floor
cards.notes: Bring a study partner and request this Solstice-equipped room at Circulation when you need to share a laptop or mobile screen.
cards.short_summary: A group room with a Solstice Pod and wall-mounted display.
cards.evidence_claim: Study Room 211 is equipped with a Solstice Pod and wall-mounted flat-panel display for sharing media from laptops or mobile devices.
cards.source_title: Study Rooms Policy | Samford University Library
cards.access_notes: Second-floor group rooms require two or more Samford undergraduate or graduate students; obtain a key at Circulation, first come first served, for a two-hour block.

cards.title: Study Room 217
cards.subtitle: Harwell G. Davis Library · second floor
cards.notes: Use this display-equipped room for a shared slide deck or media review; pick up the key from Circulation before settling in.
cards.short_summary: A second-floor group room set up for screen sharing.
cards.evidence_claim: Study Room 217 is equipped with a Solstice Pod and wall-mounted flat-panel display; Solstice supports laptop and mobile media sharing.
cards.source_title: Study Rooms Policy | Samford University Library
cards.access_notes: Group study rooms are for two or more eligible Samford students, are not reservable, and use first-come, first-served two-hour key checkout.

cards.title: Study Room 236
cards.subtitle: Harwell G. Davis Library · second floor
cards.notes: Coordinate with your group, then request this room at Circulation for a focused work block with a wall-mounted display.
cards.short_summary: A group study room with built-in Solstice display sharing.
cards.evidence_claim: Study Room 236 has a Solstice Pod and wall-mounted flat-panel display, with HDMI connection available in the room.
cards.source_title: Study Rooms Policy | Samford University Library
cards.access_notes: For groups of at least two eligible Samford undergraduate or graduate students; obtain a two-hour key checkout at the first-floor Circulation Desk.

cards.title: Media Room 111
cards.subtitle: Harwell G. Davis Library · first floor
cards.notes: Use the audiovisual setup for reserve material; group study is possible only when other study rooms are full and equipment is not needed.
cards.short_summary: A small media room with audiovisual playback equipment.
cards.evidence_claim: Media Room 111 is on Davis Library's first floor, holds one to four people, and has television, DVD, VHS, record-player, and sound-system equipment.
cards.source_title: Media Rooms Policy | Samford University Library
cards.access_notes: Media rooms primarily support audiovisual reserve or academic media. Group study is first come first served only if other study rooms are occupied and the equipment is not needed.

cards.title: Media Room 112
cards.subtitle: Harwell G. Davis Library · first floor
cards.notes: Choose this compact room when your assignment needs library audiovisual equipment, and be prepared to relocate if reserve viewing takes priority.
cards.short_summary: A one-to-four-person media room for academic viewing or listening.
cards.evidence_claim: Media Room 112 is a first-floor Davis Library media room with capacity for one to four people and connected audiovisual equipment.
cards.source_title: Media Rooms Policy | Samford University Library
cards.access_notes: First come first served for group study only when all study rooms are occupied and no patron needs the room's audiovisual equipment for reserve material.

cards.title: Media Room 113
cards.subtitle: Harwell G. Davis Library · first floor
cards.notes: Bring a small group for course media or reserve viewing; confirm that the room is not needed for equipment-based use before studying.
cards.short_summary: A media-enabled room sized for two to seven people.
cards.evidence_claim: Media Room 113 is located on the first floor of Davis Library and has capacity for two to seven people.
cards.source_title: Media Rooms Policy | Samford University Library
cards.access_notes: The room is designated for audiovisual reserve or academic media; group study is first come first served only when other study rooms are occupied and equipment use is not needed.

cards.title: Media Room 114
cards.subtitle: Harwell G. Davis Library · first floor
cards.notes: Set up a course-media session for a mid-sized group, keeping plans flexible because academic equipment use takes priority in this room.
cards.short_summary: A two-to-seven-person room with connected media equipment.
cards.evidence_claim: Media Room 114 is a first-floor Davis Library room for two to seven people with television, DVD, VHS, record-player, and sound-system equipment.
cards.source_title: Media Rooms Policy | Samford University Library
cards.access_notes: Group study is permitted first come first served only if all other study rooms are occupied and no one needs the room to use audiovisual equipment.

cards.title: Media Room 115
cards.subtitle: Harwell G. Davis Library · first floor
cards.notes: Use the largest listed media room for a course viewing or substantial group session, while yielding it when reserve-media equipment is requested.
cards.short_summary: A larger first-floor media room for up to twenty people.
cards.evidence_claim: Media Room 115 is on the first floor of Davis Library, has capacity for two to twenty people, and includes connected audiovisual equipment.
cards.source_title: Media Rooms Policy | Samford University Library
cards.access_notes: The room is for audiovisual equipment and academic media; it may be used for group study first come first served only when other study rooms are occupied and equipment is not needed.

cards.title: OBB 300
cards.subtitle: Education Learning Commons · Orlean Bullard Beeson Hall
cards.notes: Reserve OBB 300 through SPACES when you need an open collaboration setting with multiple screens and wireless display sharing.
cards.short_summary: An open study and collaboration area with three televisions.
cards.evidence_claim: OBB 300 is a relaxed, open area for studying, working, and collaboration with two 52-inch televisions, a smart television, and Mersive Solstice sharing.
cards.access_notes: Located on the third floor of Orlean Bullard Beeson Hall. The Education Learning Commons follows the academic calendar; OBB 300 can be reserved through SPACES.
